title: EviSI: An Evidence-Based Evaluation Agent for Simultaneous Interpreting
abstract: arXiv:2609.08171v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-latency simultaneous speech-to-speech translation must keep pace with ongoing speech while preserving key information. To meet these demands, systems use segmentation, reformulation and condensation to reorganize and rephrase information. However, metrics developed for text translation, including BLEU and COMET, may not consistently distinguish faithful adaptations from semantic errors. We propose EviSI, a large language model evaluation agent combining Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) with criteria developed with professional interpreters. Shared source evidence guides assessment across four dimensions: Anchor, Event, Logic and Fluency. Verified errors are deduplicated before deterministic scoring. On human-rated English to Chinese and Chinese to English data, EviSI recovers the aggregate English to Chinese human system ranking. translated_title: EviSI：一种基于证据的同声传译评估智能体
translated_abstract: 低延迟的同声传译（语音到语音翻译）必须与持续的语音保持同步，同时保留关键信息。为满足这些需求，系统会采用分割、重构和压缩等手段来重组和改写信息。然而，为文本翻译开发的指标（包括BLEU和COMET）可能无法一致地区分忠实的改写与语义错误。我们提出了EviSI，这是一个将多维质量度量（MQM）与专业口译员共同制定的标准相结合的大语言模型评估智能体。共享的源语言证据用于指导四个维度的评估：锚点、事件、逻辑和流畅度。经验证的错误在确定性评分之前会被去重。在人工评分的英译中和中译英数据上，EviSI恢复了整体的英译中人工系统排名。数据集内系统排名的平均Kendall相关性分别达到0.707和0.467。
tldr: 本文提出EviSI，一个基于大语言模型、结合多维质量度量与专业口译标准的同声传译评估智能体，通过共享源语言证据在锚点、事件、逻辑和流畅度四个维度进行评估并去重评分，实现了与人工评分高度一致的口译质量评价。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EviSI, an LLM-based evaluation agent for simultaneous interpreting that combines MQM with professional interpreter criteria, guiding assessment across Anchor, Event, Logic, and Fluency dimensions via shared source evidence with error deduplication before deterministic scoring, achieving strong agreement with human system rankings.
